resources.future_scope: Deferred explicitly before candidate results; separate scope/quality/device/cost admission required.
resources.prior_charge_scope: Includes both failed preflight allocations and 2,000 conservative prior local CPU-seconds; allocated CPU-seconds are not measured process CPU utilization.

readiness_evidence.training_reloads: Five GPU software/cost smokes completed, including both architectures at 30/300 updates; exact endpoint counts/reloads.
readiness_evidence.old_environment_failure: Job 8638765 failed before training because the old environment lacked typing_extensions.py; 6 GPU / 24 allocated CPU-seconds retained.
readiness_evidence.fresh_environment: Installed a fresh pinned core-gpu environment from the existing lock using checksum-verified Pixi 0.70.2; archived environments unchanged.
readiness_evidence.control_cost_failure: Job 8639613 used 276 GPU / 1,104 allocated CPU-seconds; five fit/reload smokes completed, then the whole-run deadline interrupted control evaluation. Its failed verdict is retained.
readiness_evidence.partial_control: All three conditional cases and the first 32 × 128 development batch completed; no completed GPU rank screen claimed. The original complete CPU control remains the quality comparator.
readiness_evidence.forecast_scope: Explicit conservative bound using the partial GPU costs and complete CPU control; not a completed GPU evaluation measurement.

memory.rule: maximum measured smoke peak ×1.5 +1GiB; not a Python-enforced memory limit
memory.partial_control_scope: Training allocator peak ×1.5 +1GiB is a forecast; unfinished control has no completed GPU allocator report. The host forecast also covers its measured Slurm batch MaxRSS.

next: Review the completed development screen. No candidate qualifies for automatic confirmation or replacement. Diagnose remaining conditional discrepancies and define a separate bounded scope before further training/reference work; reserved final panel remains closed.
metric_scope: 512 development observations × 128 draws for ranks/coverage/recovery; three cached conditional observations × 4,096 neural draws, compared with preserved 4 × 8,000 reference chains; 32 observations × 32 draws for a descriptive predictive check. One training seed per endpoint.
findings: All 14 independent fits/evaluations completed with Slurm COMPLETED/0:0, exact requested optimizer updates, endpoint reload equality and matching model bytes/evaluation identities.
None passes all predeclared development checks. All samples are finite and in support without clipping; all bounded predictive computations complete.

All four simultaneous marginal rank checks pass only for small 30,000, full 10,000 and full 30,000. Only full 30,000 also meets the coverage-within-control margin. These are development diagnostics, not confirmation or final-test results.

Full 30,000 conditional case 0 is inconclusive; cases 1 and 2 fail. Case 1 theta 90% width ratio 1.342, uncertainty interval [1.258, 1.431]; case 2 initial_variance mean difference −0.481 reference SD, interval [−0.584, −0.377], and width ratio 1.614, interval [1.512, 1.723]. These failures are not solely the original control reference-precision issue.

Training fit costs 25.5–101.2 seconds including compilation/terminal validation; whole training reports 43.9–119.1 seconds; independent evaluation reports 96.4–109.2 seconds. Cold costs dominate short budgets; no same-quality speedup over the historical CPU control is established.

Mean estimation improves before posterior calibration. Full 30,000 prior-normalized MSE is approximately 1.106/1.017/1.041/1.047 times the saved control for v0/theta/vol_of_vol/rho; these single-seed point comparisons do not imply equivalent posterior distributions.

preservation.method: Completed rsync --checksum; independently hashed all 495 regular files on Oscar and locally, with identical canonical manifests. Models and full arrays remain outside Git.

figure.scope: Mean-error learning curves and overlapping wall-time scopes. Failed overall checks remain visible; the figure alone does not assess posterior calibration.

coverage_interpretation: Development central intervals use 128 posterior draws, so finite-draw quantiles can lower coverage even under an exact posterior. The relative gate compares the saved control at the same draw count; raw nominal coverage alone is not an adequacy verdict. Conditional comparisons use 4,096 neural draws; their material discrepancies remain. The 32-draw predictive check is descriptive and successful pricing is not a predictive-adequacy pass.
